contentHtml:
Keep your home office, shop or small business running safely with a UPS and proper power protection. From working from home to protecting a point-of-sale system, I set up backup power and surge protection to suit the gear you are protecting, for homes and businesses around Stretton and Brisbane.

What a UPS does, and why you want one

A UPS keeps your devices running when the power goes out, giving you time to save your work and shut down cleanly rather than losing it. It also guards sensitive equipment against the surges and spikes that come with a Queensland summer storm, along with the voltage dips and brownouts that quietly damage electronics over time. For a home office or a small business, one short outage can mean lost work, lost sales or a costly repair.

Common situations I protect you from

  • Home office. A blackout mid-task no longer means lost work or a corrupted file.
  • Retail and point-of-sale. The register, terminal and network stay up so you can keep serving customers.
  • Modem and router. Keep the internet alive through a short outage, which matters more than ever when the phone runs over the NBN.
  • NAS and servers. A clean, automatic shutdown protects your data from an unclean power loss.

Set up and maintained

I size the UPS to what it needs to run and for how long, set it up to shut your equipment down safely, and can look after the battery replacements down the track. For wider office IT see my business IT support service, and for fitting new gear there is hardware installs.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
